parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the instance whose configuration you want to modify.

parameters.name: ModifyType
parameters.description:
The type of configuration change. Valid values:
- Upgrade: upgrade.
- Downgrade: downgrade.

sub_parameters.name: Code
sub_parameters.description:
The code of the nth module property. Valid values of n: 1 to 100. If multiple module properties exist, concatenate the parameters in the format of n=1,2,3…n.

> Specify only the module properties that need to be changed. For example, if only property A needs to be changed among properties A and B, pass only the information related to property A.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the nth module property. Valid values of n: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:
- Subscription: subscription.
- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.
